note: 1st required regularization trial of this round. trial-051 (pos_weight exponent=0.5, i.e. sqrt) gave a small AUROC gain (0.8366->0.8456) but a net-worse best-achievable F1 (0.5727->0.5007) - overcorrected precision away by upweighting rare-label positives too aggressively (range 0.61-69.14x). exponent=0.3 is a gentler compression (range 0.75-12.70x, verified before launch) - tests whether a lighter touch on the same mechanism recovers the AUROC gain without trial-051's F1 cost.

2nd required regularization trial. trial-050 inherited wd=0.5/dropout=0.2 unchanged from the old esm2_t12_35M_scale_up phase's baseline - untested whether that's actually a good choice for this new, much sparser 383-label task with only 12,000 training examples. Tests lighter weight_decay, mirroring the 'test less regularization' pattern that worked in the old aspect phase (trial-025 etc.).

batch_size was the single largest lever found in the old esm2_t12_35M_scale_up phase (batch>=64 beat batch=8 by ~0.002-0.003 val_loss, outside that phase's noise floor) - untested whether that finding transfers to this new, much sparser task. trial-050 deliberately started at batch=8 (safest, zero OOM history) rather than assuming it would; this is the first real test of batch size on the new label space.
